messages:
kai_csm: FYI LunarLogistics usage down ~62% last 30d vs prior period. Noticed new Head of Data started Apr 2, champion inactive. Putting on renewal radar. Details below.
ops_bot: [Automated report] lunar_logistics_usage.csv attached. Active seats: 48 -> 12. Monthly tokens: 3.2M -> 1.2M. trend: -62%. :warning:
maria_cs: digging in — looks like prefix caching was rolled back on their Dedicated instance after the infra patch on Apr 8. Also saw ingest pipeline errors spike around the same time.
josh_se: can you paste the token query you used? want to confirm whether rate-limits or dropped requests are to blame.
maria_cs: SQL I ran: `SELECT account_id, date_trunc('day', ts) AS d, SUM(tokens) FROM inference_logs WHERE account_id='lunar' AND ts >= '2025-03-01' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY d;`
leah_sales: fyi DealRoom notes show they accepted a pilot from AtlasAI last week. combo of new champion + competitor pilot = elevated churn risk.
kai_csm: proposed next steps: 1) confirm caching rollback caused the drop; 2) propose canary reenabling prefix cache on a subset of routes; 3) schedule sync with new Head of Data + procurement. Who can own the technical outreach? @maria_cs?
maria_cs: I can own the tech outreach. Plan to run a small A/B canary (10% traffic) to reenable prefix caching for their most common route and monitor latency/errors/cost. Will post plan.
josh_se: I'll prep a perf-impact note for sales + finance: expected token delta, latency improvement, and risk window. ETA for canary deploy ~2hr setup, monitor 24h.
leah_sales: I'll draft the outreach to the Head of Data — angle: we can run a short stability/perf pilot and show delta, no lock-in. cc procurement and the original champion. Send me the perf note when ready.
kai_csm: timeline: aim for canary by Fri 10:00 PT. If we see >30% token recovery and errors down, escalate to exec QBR and adjust renewal play. tagging: @leah_sales @josh_se @maria_cs :thumbsup: 
ops_bot: Incident created: INC-2025-042 assigned to maria_cs, priority P2.
maria_cs: starting canary plan now. Will post the change commands and a short runbook here before making the change. :eyes:
leah_sales: thanks — I'll loop in Finance for a short-term pricing buffer if we need to offer an incentive to keep them engaged.
kai_csm: agreed. I'll mark renewal probability as 'at-risk' on the renewal board until recovery. Please keep all updates here so I can copy into the renewal playbook.
maria_cs: change runbook (draft): `1) snapshot config; 2) enable prefix_cache=true on route /api/v1/translate for 10% traffic; 3) monitor tokens/errors every 15m; 4) rollback if error rate >2x baseline.` Will post metrics after first 6h.
josh_se: noted. I'll create a short perf note (1-pager) and post link here once uploaded to Drive.
leah_sales: sending a quick heads-up to the customer now referencing our pilot offer. Will bcc kai_csm.
kai_csm: thanks team. Update this thread with canary metrics and customer response.
